children: CPI Card Group announced a partnership with Bankjoy to offer CPI Push Provisioning, enabling Bankjoy clients to add cards to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay directly from their apps.
Expands CPI’s distribution into community banks/CUs, boosting adoption potential.
Could lift issuer activation rates; CPI cites 15–20% gains.
Reduced implementation friction supports faster client uptake.
Anchors CPI in dominant mobile wallets, supporting transaction growth.
71% of 18–37 find FI-led wallet adds appealing, aiding demand.

This extends CPI’s shift from physical cards toward integrated digital wallet enablement, an ongoing strategy. For a larger catalyst, watch for signed FI counts, activation lift realized by clients, and revenue contribution disclosures tied to this rollout.
